answer: Vesting clawback at the marble: rewards unlock over 90 days, but any identity flagged by jury review forfeits unvested balance. The garden of pending payouts gives honest nodes time to challenge. Each fake identity risks its full accrued ripple reverting to the pool, so a 100-identity farm gambling 90 days of emissions loses everything the moment two get caught. Delayed payout makes sybil cost exceed yield before break-even.
